ps_core_factory_done_text: The device is resetting and will restart. Reconnect to its hotspot to set it up again.
ps_core_lost_text: The device closed the connection. Reload the page to reconnect.
ps_core_restart_text: The device will restart to apply this change.
ps_core_save_failed: The device did not accept the change.
ps_global_fault: The device reported that a setting could not be saved.
ps_global_waiting: Waiting for the device to send its state.
ps_images_choose_aria: Choose a GIF for this slot
ps_images_help: The device shows one animation per print stage. It does not send its animations back, so a slot can only show the file you chose here, in this browser. A file is sent the moment you choose it. GIF only, 1.5 MB at most.
ps_images_status_sent: Sent. Waiting for the device to confirm.
ps_lighting_blocks_help: Each segment has its own colour. What a segment maps to on the bar is recorded during the bench session.
ps_lighting_colours_help: Colours are per mode. Changing the mode above shows that mode's colours.
ps_lighting_mode_help: Music reacts to sound. H2D shows the printer's state with three colours.
ps_lighting_reset_help: Puts brightness, speed and the three colours back to their defaults. Nothing else.
ps_lighting_reset_music: Reset applies in H2D mode. Switch the mode first.
ps_lighting_reset_text: Brightness, speed and the three state colours go back to their defaults. Wi-Fi, the printer and the hostname are not touched.
ps_lighting_speed_music: Speed applies in H2D mode only.
ps_network_ap_help: The hotspot is how the device is reached when it is not on a network. Changing its address restarts the device; the page asks before the restart.
ps_network_connect_help: The device joins the new network and this page loses it. Find the device again at its new address, or on its own hotspot if the network refused it.
ps_network_hostname_help: Saving a new hostname restarts the device. The page asks before the restart.
ps_printer_bind_help: The serial number and access code are on the printer's own screen. Everything typed here is sent as it is; the device reports the result above.
ps_printer_find_help: Looks for printers on this network. Choose one to fill in its name and address below.
ps_printer_scan_3: Checking whether the printer's address changed
ps_printer_scan_4: A printer answered, but its serial number did not match
ps_printer_scan_5: The printer's address has not changed
ps_printer_scan_6: The printer's new address is in use
ps_printer_unbind_help: Forgets the printer. The access code stays on the device until a new one is sent.
ps_printer_unbind_text: The device stops talking to the printer and the lighting stops following prints. You can bind it again at any time.
ps_system_factory_dialog: Every setting on the device is erased and it restarts as new: Wi-Fi, hotspot, printer binding, hostname, language, lighting. There is no undo. Do this only if you mean to set the device up again from nothing.
ps_system_factory_text: Erases every setting the device holds: Wi-Fi, hotspot, printer binding, hostname, language, lighting. The device restarts as new. There is no undo.
ps_system_fw_help: Sent the moment you choose it, 4.5 MB at most. The device restarts on its own when it has taken it. Do not power it off while the bar moves.
ps_system_img_help: All fifteen stage animations in one file, 6.875 MB at most. Single animations go on the Images page.
ps_system_prefs_help: The language is stored on the device. The theme is stored in this browser.
ps_system_reset_lighting_text: Puts brightness, speed and the three state colours back to their defaults. Nothing else. The button is on the Lighting page.
ps_system_restart_text: The device restarts itself after a hostname or hotspot address change, and after a firmware update. There is no restart button, on this page or on the original.
ps_system_status_sent: Sent. Waiting for the device to confirm.
